title: Spring sensitivity, Nelson normalization and frequency/complex-response inverse
source: Independent differentiation of u=F/k, W=F²/k, lambda=k/m, f=sqrt(k/m)/(2 pi); direct/adjoint method: Adelman and Haftka, NASA TM-86333 (1984), equations (4)-(7). Harmonic Z=k-omega² m+i eta k, u=F/Z, du/dk=-(1+i eta)F/Z²; at omega=2, k=4, m=1, eta=1/2 the derivative is 1/4+i/8. Nelson normalization gives zero vector derivative for fixed unit mass.
